themes.title: Far-Right Momentum and Electoral Contestation Ahead of Major Votes
themes.blurb: Right-wing parties across Europe are navigating high-stakes polling shifts, coalition dynamics, and aggressive campaign framing. From Marine Le Pen maintaining her presidential polling lead in France and Vox confronting the Spanish government in media broadsides, to AfD clashing with mainstream parties in Germany and Sverigedemokraterna adjusting coalition leverage in Sweden, right-wing movements are actively shaping upcoming election cycles.

themes.title: Judicial Crackdowns and Surveillance Targeting the Far-Right
themes.blurb: Prominent right-wing political figures and their inner circles face expanding legal investigations, ethics probes, and law enforcement actions. In Brazil, federal authorities continue long-running fake news inquiries against Bolsonarista figures; in Hungary, Viktor Orbán's brother was detained in a human trafficking probe; and in the UK and US, top party figures face official sleaze inquiries and impeachment resolutions.

themes.title: National Priority Rhetoric and Hardline Migration Demands
themes.blurb: Right-wing movements across Europe and North America are intensifying rhetoric centered on national preference, border defense, and strict identity policy. Leaders are demanding hardline restrictions on foreign aid, cultural integration, and migration while asserting sovereign national priority over international frameworks.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland
